start.name_zh: 旧县街道（铜梁区，'Jiu County'为'旧县'字面翻译）
start.name_en: Jiuxian Subdistrict, Tongliang District ('Jiu County' = literal translation of 旧县, 'old county')
start.geocode_source: No single named valve chamber matched to this branch's tap point; 旧县街道 is the nearest sourced place repeatedly mentioned in the EIA (construction road crossings, water wells) near the Tongliang/Hechuan district boundary, which the trunk's own km-0 point also sits near (see P7568). Coordinate is a groundwater monitoring well ('第高村6组', unlabeled well ID) at 106.244E/29.899N, ~60m from the pipeline centerline per the doc; two other nearby wells in the same subdistrict (106.187/29.886 and 106.224/29.893) corroborate the area.

end.name_zh: 合川区（合川供气支线/合川供气管道）
end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '合川区,重庆市' -> OSM relation 2693399, district administrative-boundary centroid. Matches GEM's generic EndLocation='Hechuan'.

corridor_notes: Short local gas-supply branch (供气支线) tapping the trunk near the Tongliang/Hechuan district boundary (旧县街道 area, Tongliang side) and running into 合川区 (Hechuan District) to serve local gas demand -- the near-boundary tap point is expected, since this branch's whole purpose is to feed Hechuan District right where the trunk crosses into it. The Phase 2 EIA explicitly lists '合川供气管道' among the 8 Phase 3 supply branches (combined 135.6km across 7 Chongqing districts + Badong County, Hubei). See P7568 for the Phase 2/Phase 3 labeling note.
researcher_notes: Unlike the other 6 branches, no specific numbered valve chamber matches this one's GEM start-location field ('Jiu County') -- 旧县街道 is well-attested in the EIA as a place the trunk crosses, but not tied to a named tap/valve point for a branch. Start coordinate uses a different one of the three nearby monitoring wells than P7568's boundary proxy (both sets of wells are within ~1km of each other in the same subdistrict) to avoid an artifactual coordinate collision between the two PIDs, while flagging that both branches plausibly originate from roughly the same physical area (the trunk's Tongliang/Hechuan boundary crossing). This is a real corridor-proximity finding worth a human look, not a data error to fix here.
blockers: No named valve chamber or tap point specific to this branch was found in either master EIA; start point is a best-available nearest-township proxy rather than a confirmed branch origin.
